metadata.question: Did did the total rainfall exceed 6 inches in Grafton, New South Wales during January 14, 2020 to January 22, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I will use the CHIRPS Daily dataset (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) which provides daily rainfall in mm. This covers Australia and has data for 2020. I will filter for the exact date range and the location of Grafton, NSW. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking is needed since CHIRPS is a gauge-satellite merged product with daily precipitation estimates, not optical imagery. 3. Logic: Sum all daily rainfall over the 9-day window (14–22 Jan 2020). 6 inches ≈ 152.4 mm. Check the summed value: if None/NaN → C3; if sum > 152.4 mm → A; else → B. Also guard against empty collection (C1) or zero valid pixels (C2). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.9353, -29.6906]) # Grafton, NSW start = '2020-01-14' end = '2020-01-23' # inclusive upper bound # 2. Data Acquisition & Check col = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(grafton)) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No rainfall images found.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Processing: sum rainfall over interval total_rain = col.sum().select('precipitation') count = total_rain.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=grafton, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") exit() # 4. Calculation total_mm = total_rain.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.first(), geometry=grafton, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer if total_mm is None or str(total_mm)=='nan': print("C3") else: print(f"Sum: {total_mm:.2f} mm, Pixels: {int(count)}") if total_mm > 152.4: # 6 inches print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
grafton = ee.Geometry.Point([152.9353, -29.6906])  # Grafton, NSW
start = '2020-01-14'
end   = '2020-01-23'  # inclusive upper bound

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
col = (ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
       .filterDate(start, end)
       .filterBounds(grafton))
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No rainfall images found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Processing: sum rainfall over interval
total_rain = col.sum().select('precipitation')
count = total_rain.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=grafton,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()
if count == 0:
    print("No valid pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculation
total_mm = total_rain.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
    geometry=grafton,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9).get('precipitation').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
if total_mm is None or str(total_mm)=='nan':
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Sum: {total_mm:.2f} mm, Pixels: {int(count)}")
    if total_mm > 152.4:  # 6 inches
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
